mentions.name: Ameliorate
mentions.description: A webapp for collaboratively thinking critically about problems. Users build diagrams containing all details about a problem along with people's thoughts on it, organized so it can be continuously refined down to the smallest detail, creating a concrete shared understanding to reach better decisions. Current work includes UX to hide intermediate nodes while still drawing indirect edges, and a planned LLM integration to generate and update diagrams via natural language to lower usage barriers.
